verdicts.quote: "With what arm, boy?" The shield hung on its strap from the saddle-bow where it had hung all morning. Rickard's left arm was bound across his chest.
verdicts.reason: Rickard cannot raise the shield and fights right-handed only, with the narration showing the shoulder limiting him.

verdicts.quote: the cudgel in his left hand because the right was no good for it. It felt wrong there.
verdicts.reason: Marro's splinted right hand is never used to fight; he carries the cudgel awkwardly in his left.

verdicts.quote: The sheath was empty. Of course it was empty. The dagger was at the bottom of the Rhoyne with Dagna
verdicts.reason: The GM corrects the dagger attempt in the fiction and Marro has only the cudgel.
